shots.action: Two men in fedoras and trench coats stand talking on the open deck of a ferry, the sea and a chain-link railing behind them.
A uniformed officer in a peaked cap speaks to two men in trench coats and fedoras on the road by the dock, with armed guards, a jeep and the moored ferry behind them.

A wide view of the institution's manicured grounds and fortress-like stone building gives way to the two hatted marshals walking in through the brick gate past uniformed guards while a uniformed officer talks to them on the lawn.
In a wood-panelled office, a bald man in a tweed suit and bow tie stands by his desk gesturing with a pipe as he speaks to two seated men in suits.
Crouched in a dim room, Teddy Daniels peers into a narrow gap and picks up a small folded scrap of paper, then unfolds it in his hands to show the handwritten words "THE LAW OF 4 / WHO IS 67?".
At night three men in overcoats and hats walk away from a lit brick building, Dr. Cawley in close-up talking as he walks, before the camera holds on the dark rain-slicked facility exterior.
Two men in hats and overcoats stand silhouetted against the grounds behind a tall chain-link fence, then talk face to face in close-up through the wire as one lights the other's cigarette.

In a dim ferry cabin Teddy sits in the foreground while Chuck, seated against the bulkhead opposite him, fidgets with his hands and talks to him, with a brief cut to a misty snow-dusted pine forest between the two angles.

In a dim wood-panelled room a man in a grey suit holds up a metal flask as he speaks to another man, whose face is then seen in close-up with a lit cigarette in his mouth, cut against an overhead view of three bloodied children's bodies lying on a patterned carpet beside a woman in a red dress.

Orderlies in white struggle with patients across the beds of a dim ward dormitory, a man in a white coat leans in to light a cigarette for another man seated beside him, and a lone white-clad figure stands in the arched stone entrance of the brick hospital building.
In a dark brick basement corridor by a stone staircase, a heavyset uniformed guard in a peaked cap speaks across the frame to Teddy and Chuck, who stand together in white coats and listen.
In a dim cell block, an over-the-shoulder view holds on a bald, shirtless man hunched on a bunk, then cuts to a close-up of Teddy's bruised face watching him through the iron bars.
Two men in pale clothing stand at the edge of a wooded sea cliff looking out at a lighthouse on the rocks below, then talk facing each other among the trees.

Inside a dark cave lit by a small fire, a woman in a grey institutional dress stands against the rock wall talking toward an out-of-focus man in the foreground, holding a knife at her side in the later frames.
A uniformed man waits at the wheel of an army jeep on a wooded road and looks back as Teddy, in a pale jacket, walks over and climbs in, and the jeep drives on past a weathered building.
Dr. Cawley stands beside a flip chart in a stone room, speaking and gesturing at the handwritten anagrams "EDWARD DANIELS-ANDREW LAEDDIS" and "RACHEL SOLANDO-DOLORES CHANAL".

In a dim brick corridor a rain-soaked Teddy Daniels in a pale jacket faces a man in a dark suit across the passage, then the camera holds on Teddy's face in close-up as he stares off and his expression hardens.

In a lamplit stone room a dark-haired man in a tweed suit talks urgently at a man seen from behind, with a brief cut to two men grappling on the iron stairs of a brick lighthouse, before a bald older man holds up a photograph of a dead boy for the same listener to look at.
In close-up outdoors, a soaked blonde woman in a yellow floral dress cradles the back of a man's head while speaking to him, and he then doubles over sobbing against her on the grass.
Tight two-shot of Teddy and Chuck standing close together outside a columned building, talking low as Teddy studies him with a tense frown.
